For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Nawal Kishore Prasad, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR JHA
ORAL ORDER 2 19-08-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. In this present case, the petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 800 of 2020, registered for the offences under Sections 323, 341 and 354 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. As per prosecution case, complainant alleged that the petitioner no.1 sold a piece land to the complainant giving right of way on certain portion but later on he sold another plot Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.53068 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 of land along with that portion to co-accused Manorma Devi and Tetri Devi.
When the complainant went to the house of the petitioner no.1, he put her down and pulled her saree and sexually assaulted her.
All the petitioners abused and drove out the complainant and her husband from their house.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case.
No occurrence as alleged has ever taken place.
There is no injury report of the complainant.
Petitioner no.1 did not sell the passage to co-accused Manorma Devi and Tetri Devi.
Even if the co-accused persons encroached upon the passage, the petitioner no.1 could not be held liable for the same.
It is also apparent from the complaint that no hindrance was caused for four years after purchase of the land by the complainant.

No offence under Sections 420, 467 and 468 of I.P.C is made out against the petitioners and allegation for offence under Section 354 of I.P.C. against petitioner no.1 is completely false and fabricated.
Petitioners have been made accused in this case by the complainant in order to pressurized and blackmail him.
5. Learned APP opposes the submissions made on behalf of the petitioners.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.53068 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 6.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances and submissions made on behalf of the parties and considering the vague nature of allegation coupled with possibility of false implication, let the petitioners above named, in the event of their arrest or surrender before the court concerned within a period of eight weeks from today, be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-1st, Banka/concerned court in connection with Complaint Case No. 800 of 2020, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and other following conditions:
(i) One of the bailors will be a close relative of the petitioners.
(ii) The petitioners will remain present on each and every date fixed by the court below, if so required by the learned trial court.
(Arun Kumar Jha, J) balmukund/-
